headline: Trump Administration Proposes New Tariffs on China, EU, and 12 Other Partners
summary: The US administration proposed new tariffs on 14 trading partners, including China and the European Union, featuring an added 20% tax on Chinese imports to take effect early next year.
why: Tariffs alter trade dynamics, increase import costs for businesses and consumers, and can trigger retaliatory measures by trading partners, impacting global supply chains.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Broad equity indices can be affected by trade tensions and tariff proposals affecting multinational corporate earnings.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Proposed broad tariffs introduce regulatory and cost uncertainty for international trade, affecting market sentiment.
